name: BrownSuger
source:
A story about a female soldier who belongs to a team of counter-terrorism and an army physician who is newly transferred.

The army physician tries to "coordinate" with the female soldier to have a consensual relationship with her.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ054974.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
故事围绕一名隶属反恐部队的女兵，以及一位新调任的军医展开。

军医试图与女兵进行“协调”，以便让她自愿与自己发生关系。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ054974.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
